metadata.description: Name of the Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace.
Unique identifier for the analytics rule.

properties.displayName: SQL-DB-usecase5 - Long Running SQL Query Exceeding 1 Hour - SecurityEvent
properties.description: Detects SQL Server Audit event 33205 records ingested into SecurityEvent when query execution exceeds 3,600,000 milliseconds (one hour). Approved users and service accounts are excluded case-insensitively. Replace the placeholder entries in ApprovedOrServiceAccounts, validate the query against the workspace's EventData format, and then enable the rule.
properties.query:
let LongRunningThresholdMs = 3600000;
let ApprovedOrServiceAccounts = dynamic([
    "replace_with_approved_user",
    "replace_with_approved_service_account"
]);
SecurityEvent
| where EventSourceName =~ "MSSQLSERVER" and EventID == 33205
| extend RawEventData = tostring(EventData)
| extend ParsedEventData = trim(" ", replace_regex(replace_regex(RawEventData, @"<[^>]+>", " "), @"\s+", " "))
| extend QueryDurationMs = tolong(coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<DurationMilliseconds>(\d+)</DurationMilliseconds>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)duration_milliseconds(?:\x22|\x27)>(\d+)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bduration_milliseconds\s*[=:]\s*(\d+)\b", 1, ParsedEventData)))
| where QueryDurationMs > LongRunningThresholdMs
| extend DatabaseUser = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<ServerPrincipalName>(.*?)</ServerPrincipalName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<SessionServerPrincipalName>(.*?)</SessionServerPrincipalName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)(?:server_principal_name|session_server_principal_name)(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\b(?:server_principal_name|session_server_principal_name)\s*[=:]\s*([^;]+?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend DatabaseUser = trim(" ", DatabaseUser)
| where isempty(DatabaseUser) or DatabaseUser !in~ (ApprovedOrServiceAccounts)
| extend RawSqlStatement = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<Statement>(.*?)</Statement>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)statement(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bstatement\s*[=:]\s*(.*?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend SqlStatement = substring(trim(" ", replace_regex(RawSqlStatement, @"\s+", " ")), 0, 4000)
| extend DatabaseName = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<DatabaseName>(.*?)</DatabaseName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)database_name(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bdatabase_name\s*[=:]\s*([^;]+?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend SourceClient = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<ClientIp>(.*?)</ClientIp>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)client_ip(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bclient_ip\s*[=:]\s*([^; ]+)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend ApplicationName = coalesce(
    extract(@"(?is)<ApplicationName>(.*?)</ApplicationName>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?is)<Data\s+Name=(?:\x22|\x27)application_name(?:\x22|\x27)>(.*?)</Data>", 1, RawEventData),
    extract(@"(?i)\bapplication_name\s*[=:]\s*(.*?)(?:\s+[A-Za-z_]+\s*[=:]|$)", 1, ParsedEventData))
| extend DatabaseHost = Computer
| extend SourceIpAddress = extract(@"((?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}|[0-9A-Fa-f:]{2,})", 1, SourceClient)
| extend QueryDuration = format_timespan(QueryDurationMs * 1ms, "dd.hh:mm:ss.fff")
| project TimeGenerated, DatabaseUser, DatabaseName, DatabaseHost, SourceClient, SourceIpAddress, ApplicationName, QueryDurationMs, QueryDuration, SqlStatement, Computer, EventID, EventSourceName, Activity

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: SQL query exceeded 1 hour by {{DatabaseUser}} on {{DatabaseHost}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: A SQL query executed by {{DatabaseUser}} on {{DatabaseHost}} ran for {{QueryDuration}}. Review the database name, exact duration, SQL statement, source client, and application context in the alert details.
